title: Concrete native scalar models and evaluation transpose
statement: Let X be a scheme in universe u, Lambda a commutative condensed ring in abelian groups of universe u+1, A a commutative ring in universe u+1, and alpha from the constant sheaf A to the section coefficient ring B on the small pro-etale site of X [def-weil-pbc-strict-perfect-coefficient-package, def-weil-pbc-internal-abelian-sheaf-module-equivalence]. Define realization as ordinary constant-module scalar extension followed by the inverse section-action equivalence, chart as its termwise cochain functor, and scalarDual as the scalar Hom complex into A[0]. The counit gives sectionChartIso and thus normalized scalarSection r tensor v and scalar(a). Define nativeUnit as the actual native derived tensor unit, evaluationTranspose by the actual tensor-Hom adjunction and its counit with the prescribed two braidings, sectionDerivedHomMap by the localization isomorphism, and tensorTargetMap by tensoring a chain map on the right with chart(scalarDual P). All formulas, signatures and attributes are recorded verbatim in lean.statement. Realization is additive because scalar extension is additive and the inverse section equivalence preserves binary products.

source.place: Tags 08JH and 08JJ; finite-free dual calculation and evaluation localization.

proof.text: Define each object by the existing constructions. Scalar extension is additive; the inverse equivalence preserves binary products and is therefore additive. Compose these instances.
